cards.back:
As a result.
Bahasa Indonesia: akibatnya, oleh karena itu
Example: The river flooded. Consequently, the road was closed.
cards.say: consequently. As a result. The river flooded. Consequently, the road was closed.

cards.back:
In spite of that.
Bahasa Indonesia: meskipun begitu
Example: The test was hard. Nonetheless, she finished it on time.
cards.say: nonetheless. In spite of that. The test was hard. Nonetheless, she finished it on time.

cards.back:
In the opposite way.
Bahasa Indonesia: sebaliknya
Example: Cats like to be alone. Conversely, dogs enjoy company.
cards.say: conversely. In the opposite way. Cats like to be alone. Conversely, dogs enjoy company.

cards.back:
In addition, and more importantly.
Bahasa Indonesia: selain itu, lagi pula
Example: The plan is cheap. Moreover, it is easy to carry out.
cards.say: moreover. In addition, and more importantly. The plan is cheap. Moreover, it is easy to carry out.

cards.back:
Used to show a clear difference between two things.
Bahasa Indonesia: berbeda dengan itu
Example: The north is dry. In contrast, the south is very wet.
cards.say: in contrast. Used to show a clear difference between two things. The north is dry. In contrast, the south is very wet.

cards.back:
In the same way.
Bahasa Indonesia: demikian pula
Example: Wolves hunt in packs. Similarly, lions hunt together.
cards.say: similarly. In the same way. Wolves hunt in packs. Similarly, lions hunt together.

cards.back:
Afterwards, at a later time.
Bahasa Indonesia: selanjutnya, kemudian
Example: He lost his key and subsequently called a locksmith.
cards.say: subsequently. Afterwards, at a later time. He lost his key and subsequently called a locksmith.

cards.back:
Before this time, or in the past.
Bahasa Indonesia: sebelumnya
Example: The shop was previously a bookshop. Now it is a cafe.
cards.say: previously. Before this time, or in the past. The shop was previously a bookshop. Now it is a cafe.

cards.back:
Used to give a different choice.
Bahasa Indonesia: sebagai gantinya, atau
Example: We can take the bus. Alternatively, we could cycle.
cards.say: alternatively. Used to give a different choice. We can take the bus. Alternatively, we could cycle.

cards.back:
Because of. It is followed by a noun.
Bahasa Indonesia: karena, disebabkan oleh
Example: The match was moved on account of the wet pitch.
cards.say: on account of. Because of. It is followed by a noun. The match was moved on account of the wet pitch.

cards.back:
Even though there is a problem or difficulty. It is followed by a noun.
Bahasa Indonesia: meskipun, walaupun
Example: In spite of the cold, we swam in the sea.
cards.say: in spite of. Even though there is a problem or difficulty. It is followed by a noun. In spite of the cold, we swam in the sea.

cards.back:
The same as in spite of. It is followed by a noun.
Bahasa Indonesia: walaupun, biarpun
Example: Despite the rain, the parade continued down the street.
cards.say: despite. The same as in spite of. It is followed by a noun. Despite the rain, the parade continued down the street.

cards.back:
Only if. It gives a condition.
Bahasa Indonesia: selama, asalkan
Example: You may go out as long as you wear a coat.
cards.say: as long as. Only if. It gives a condition. You may go out as long as you wear a coat.

cards.back:
On the condition that.
Bahasa Indonesia: dengan syarat bahwa, asalkan
Example: You can borrow it provided that you return it on Friday.
cards.say: provided that. On the condition that. You can borrow it provided that you return it on Friday.

cards.back:
Every time that.
Bahasa Indonesia: setiap kali, kapan pun
Example: Whenever it rains, the frogs begin to sing.
cards.say: whenever. Every time that. Whenever it rains, the frogs begin to sing.

cards.back:
During the time that. A more formal form of while.
Bahasa Indonesia: sementara, selagi
Example: Whilst the water boils, chop the carrots into slices.
cards.say: whilst. During the time that. A more formal form of while. Whilst the water boils, chop the carrots into slices.

cards.back:
Until something happens, or while you wait.
Bahasa Indonesia: sementara itu
Example: Dinner is not ready. In the meantime, you can read.
cards.say: in the meantime. Until something happens, or while you wait. Dinner is not ready. In the meantime, you can read.

cards.back:
Used to begin a short summary.
Bahasa Indonesia: singkatnya, kesimpulannya
Example: To sum up, the experiment showed that plants need light.
cards.say: to sum up. Used to begin a short summary. To sum up, the experiment showed that plants need light.

cards.back:
Used to give an example.
Bahasa Indonesia: misalnya, contohnya
Example: Some birds, for instance penguins, cannot fly.
cards.say: for instance. Used to give an example. Some birds, for instance penguins, cannot fly.

cards.back:
Generally, thinking of everything.
Bahasa Indonesia: secara keseluruhan
Example: On the whole, the trip was a great success.
cards.say: on the whole. Generally, thinking of everything. On the whole, the trip was a great success.

cards.back:
Especially.
Bahasa Indonesia: terutama
Example: I like all fruit, mangoes in particular.
cards.say: in particular. Especially. I like all fruit, mangoes in particular.

cards.back:
And also.
Bahasa Indonesia: serta
Example: She plays the flute as well as the piano.
cards.say: as well as. And also. She plays the flute as well as the piano.
